attchmntText: Liberty Shoes Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Compliance of communication received from Stock Exchanges- Board comments on the fine levied by Stock Exchanges'.
voiceSummary: Liberty Shoes Limited disclosed receipt of non-compliance notices from the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange dated 14th October 2026. The exchanges levied a fine of Rs. 17,700, inclusive of GST, for a three-day delay in filing an application to reclassify two promoter shareholders from the Promoter and Promoter Group category to the Public category under Regulation 31A. The Board of Directors reviewed the matter in its meeting held on 12th November 2026. The Board noted the delay was procedural, caused by delayed receipt of documents from promoters and intervening public holidays. The Board confirmed there was no mala fide intention or deliberate default. The company has submitted a request to the exchanges seeking a waiver of the delay and the consequential fine. The Board authorized the CFO and Company Secretary to communicate these comments to the exchanges.

attchmntText: Liberty Shoes Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Liberty Shoes Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 12th November 2026. Revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 36,032.64 lakh. Profit before tax was Rs. 303.09 lakh. Profit for the period was Rs. 210.37 lakh. Earnings per share was Rs. 1.23. Total assets stood at Rs. 52,756.89 lakh. The Statutory Auditors issued a Limited Review Report. The results are available on the NSE and BSE websites.
